g.title: C1
g.text: PTFE; 2 wires per pole, 3 A each derated (SQSO-HAR-001 5.2); 1.3 A worst load, 5 A fuse F2

g.title: C2
g.text: NTC1 pair (own return, isolated from the cells) twisted; heater pair twisted, 79 mA at 16.4 V

g.title: P2
g.text: battery side, cell taps and NTC2

g.title: C3
g.text: sense only; NTC2 returns to TAP0 inside the pack

g.title: J2
g.text: EPS board J2 to AFE U1 (100 Ohm + 0.1 uF) and secondary protector U2 (1 kOhm + 0.1 uF)
